source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Wired Network Connections' (PDF 17): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Wired network devices ko jorne ke liye cables istemal karta hai. Wired networks mein aam taur par Ethernet cables istemal hoti hain. Devices seedhe router ya switch se jure hote hain. Wired connections high speed (tez raftar) aur stable (barabar, baghair tootne ke) performance dete hain. Yeh networks wireless networks se zyada secure (mehfooz) hain. Lekin cables ki wajah se devices azadi se idhar udhar move nahi kar sakte.

blocks.prompt: Wired connection ke do fawaid aur ek nuqsan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Fawaid: tez aur stable, wireless se zyada mehfooz. Nuqsan: cables ki wajah se devices azadi se hil nahi sakte.

items: Wired: Ethernet cables, seedha router/switch se; tez, stable, zyada mehfooz; devices hil nahi sakte.
